reviews.text:
If I could give 0 stars, I would. I have a 1-year care plan here for my cat. I brought her in last week for his annual vaccination, and for an entire week now, she hasn't been able to walk or eat and is in severe pain.

When I brought her back, reception charged me £85—£50 for a solution that costs £4 online, plus £45 for a consultation. When I pointed out that I pay £16.50 a month for the care plan, I was told I can only get 2 consultations a year.

My cat was completely healthy before this. Due to the vet's lack of experience and improper injection technique, my cat is now suffering horribly. Absolute zero customer service!"
will be reporting this to the relevant authorities.

Huge thank you to the staff for fitting me in with my cat last minute. He had cystitis and had to have his bladder manually drained. Our vet Cristiana was lovely, she gave some great advice on how to manage his condition and she clearly loves animals. My cat is now very much enjoying the gabapentin he was prescribed and doing better.

An absolutely appalling level of customer service

I would strongly recommend thinking twice before using Vets for Pets.

My ex-partner and I purchased a dog together and used Vets for Pets for his veterinary care, including a monthly care plan. When we later separated, I transferred ownership of the dog to my ex-partner because she was in a better position to provide him with the life and care he deserved.

What followed was an absolute farce.

The ownership transfer paperwork was not properly completed by Vets for Pets, and nobody made it clear to me that transferring ownership of the dog would not automatically transfer the associated care plan within their system.

I subsequently received a call telling me I owed around £60 because I had cancelled my care plan.
I explained that the care plan for the exact same dog was still active and being paid for by my ex-partner.

In other words, Vets for Pets were still receiving payment for the dog's care there had simply been a change in who was responsible for the dog.
Their response? It apparently "doesn't matter" because their T&Cs state that I am liable for the cancellation fee.

So, according to Vets for Pets, despite one dog having one active care plan, their position was effectively that two people should be paying for care plans for the same animal because their internal ownership and payment systems hadn't been properly transferred.

Imagine taking over someone's financed car and being told the previous owner still has to pay a cancellation charge because the finance company's internal systems weren't updated properly. That's essentially the logic being applied here.
But honestly, the money isn't even the part that annoys me most.

It's the complete lack of empathy, compassion and basic customer service.

I was repeatedly interrupted on the phone, spoken to dismissively and given absolutely no sense that the person I was speaking to had any understanding of the circumstances. I explained that breakups happen, pets are involved, and people make decisions about ownership and care based on what is best for the animal.

I even suggested that, if this is genuinely how their system works, they should make this incredibly clear to customers going through an ownership transfer in the future.

The response was essentially:

"It's in the T&Cs."

That was it.

Apparently someone going through a breakup, transferring ownership of their puppy and trying to do the responsible thing for their pet is expected to stop and scrutinise the small print to ensure Vets for Pets continues to receive payment in exactly the way their database expects.

There was no attempt to understand the situation. No meaningful explanation. No ownership of the fact that their own transfer process had not been completed properly. No goodwill. Just repeatedly hiding behind the T&Cs.

A business dealing with people's beloved pets should have care and compassion at the heart of what it does. Unfortunately, my experience was that the customer was treated as an inconvenience and the dog was reduced to an account number and payment plan.

The veterinary care itself may be perfectly adequate, but customer service is part of the experience and in my experience, Vets for Pets failed spectacularly.

I would personally avoid them in future. There are plenty of independent and private veterinary practices where you can receive a far more personal, compassionate and human level of care.

My dog deserved better. Frankly, so did I.
Found a bird that was not very well and once we brought her in the receptionist looked slightly annoyed at us.

I brought in a stray cat I'd bonded with that needed urgent veterinary care. The younger receptionist's first concern was telling me I needed a carrier, despite me being there for an emergency. It wasn't until her colleague pointed out it was an emergency that she shooed me away with her hand and said go over there. She was rude, abrupt and had absolutely no common sense.

The older receptionist spent more time staring at us and making us feel judged than being helpful. It honestly felt like she'd already decided we were trying to get free treatment before we'd even spoken properly. Meanwhile, she was perfectly friendly to PAYING customers bringing in their own pets.

If you're the first people someone meets in a veterinary practice, especially when they're trying to help an animal in distress, the least you can do is show some basic respect. The attitude from both receptionists was appalling and completely lacking in empathy.

The one star is for Hazel who was so polite and understanding.
Carolina , Lucy and Cristina

honestly cannot praise Claire, Lucy, and Jon at reception highly enough. From the very first moment you walk through the doors, you are treated with such warmth, professionalism and genuine care that it instantly puts you at ease.

Claire and Lucy are simply incredible🤍their kindness, patience, understanding, and dedication to both animals and owners is something truly special. You can see how deeply they care about every pet that comes through the practice, and that level of compassion is rare to find.

The service they provide should honestly be the example for every company that deals with customers face to face. In a world where genuine customer care can sometimes feel forgotten, this team reminds you exactly how people should be treated. Nothing felt rushed, and no question is ever too much.

They are an absolute credit to vets4pets and I am beyond grateful for everything they did(especially after having bad experiences at other vets). Thank you for your kindness and professionalism. Truly outstanding people and outstanding service.
Very helpful staff, they are always very respectful

Just registered with this vets yesterday,
My kitten hadn’t pooped in a couple days and I was extremely worried especially for his age. The vets at this practice preformed a small Enema on him, personally I was worried about the price of this vet visit especially because I didn’t have insurance yet, but it totalled to be beyond reasonable!
The vets also advised me on his diet going forward to prevent this happening again, and guidance on pet insurance.
It’s only been a day but with their advice Kyro is now using his litter tray as normal and enjoying his new diet :)
Above and beyond, excellent service.
Couldn’t recommend them more!!!

She is well now all due to the wonderful care of the vets and all the staff at Vets  for Pets at Kirkstall  , I can never thank them enough  . Thank you Cristiana . And lots of love to Marco as well he saved the life of Sarah she had a very bad accident  and was dying when i rushed her to Pets for Vets he knew he didnt have the things at that moment but got the receptionist  Steven  to ring a excellent  hispital where she stayed 8 weeks but recovered whar Marco did was wonderful  . lots of love Cindy . Sarah . Mitzi  and Alice . I'll never forget your kindness to me and my doggies so glad your back where all the staff are amazing like you xx

I am extremely disappointed and frustrated with this grooming service. Despite clearly providing a reference photo of the previous groom, they completely failed to deliver anything even remotely similar. It honestly feels like they didn’t even try.

They only focused on the body and completely ignored the face, which is the most important part. The result looks unfinished and frankly ridiculous. On top of that, they labeled my dog as “aggressive” for no valid reason, even though this was never the case before. This is not only inaccurate but also completely unprofessional. Properly handling dogs is part of their job, and it is their responsibility to manage and work with them appropriately during grooming.

Their attitude and behavior were just as bad as the result — careless, dismissive, and far from professional. I feel like I’ve been misled and my money was wasted on something that does not meet even basic expectations.

I strongly do NOT recommend this grooming service to anyone.

Went to see the vet last week with my cats poorly eye. I was given the same treatment for him, even though I told the vet he’d had this before and it didn’t work. It cost me £132! I won’t be returning to this vet

Quick consultation with 2 fleas tablets cost £52. I find it very expensive so I asked for prescriptions so I can buy the fleas tabs with VioVet. Contacted them via WhatsApp and was told they will give me the prescriptions. When I was told to collect the prescriptions, it wasn’t ready and was told I have to pay £21 and after I agreed, I felt I’ve been tricked as she tried to charge me £42. I was then told again it’s £21 each dog’s prescriptions . I told the receptionist I never experienced this to any other branch of Vers4Pets then I walked away. This branch in Kirkstall is a total ripped off. So I registered my Chihuahua somewhere else.

Vet for Pets at kirkstall Leeds are the very best , in the time my  dogs have been going there  they have saved 2 of my dogs lives . They are so kind to me and my dogs in the 9 yrs they have been going there , the vets,  Nurses and the reception staff are the very best and I wouldn't dream of going any where else .
The team have been amazing! Lindsey, Jayne and the rest have been so helpful and understanding. Definitely the best vets I’ve ever been to, they really look after your fur baby.

I’ve never had a bad experience with this branch.
They took great care of my cat, Eliza when she was spayed yesterday and even called to let me know how she was! (that was much appreciated as I had been on edge since she was dropped off).
Receptionists are absolutely lovely both in person and via phone and the vets are super even if Eliza doesn’t like going.
Great vets, receptionist are really helpful and the vets and nurses are amazing it feels like the whole team actually care about your pets 🙂 …

I just wanted to say a massive thank you to the whole team for looking after Theo.
We’ve had multiple appointments for our cat in the last 4 months. Jo and Andreaa have been amazing and have helped him from his very first check up to getting him neutered, they’re a real credit to the team.

I also wanted to say a big thank you to everyone on the reception team. They’ve all been so helpful both on the phone and when we’ve been in. Thank you 🐈
They treat my baby 🐈‍⬛well and especially Andreea who is a lovely vet and took care of my 🐈‍⬛ during his surgery, nice staff too. …
Amazing vets

Jo and Claire at kirkstall are just so lovely and helpful , they’ve helped me with my cat over the last few weeks and his cystitis and UTI. Guided me all the way ,on the ball and just great nurses , quick response and just generally caring people it’s a privilege to be part of this vets and that they have time to deal with storm my cat . Thank you ladies much appreciated keep doing what your doing your very much appreciated , fab work your an asset to the company . Claire Eden
Managed to fit me in same day for an emergency appointment and the vet was super lovely and handled my extra spooky cat very gently. Would recommend.

Had another fantastic experience with Hazel at Vets4Pets Kirkstall.

Theo went in for a sedation groom, and from start to finish, Hazel made the whole process feel calm and reassuring for him. She really took care of him - Theo was in great hands.

Her kindness, professionalism, and that extra thoughtful touch (thank you for the brownie!) made all the difference.

I can’t recommend her enough!

They looked after my cockerpoo Ralph yesterday so well. He has to have an operation and be kept for the day and sedated. They made this feel so normal and were so calm.

From arrival the front desk team are friendly, I didn’t have to wait long to be seen.

The vet was friendly and knowledgeable and delivered the information in a way that was easy to understand. They took care to explain the procedure answer all my questions and resssure me it was okay.

The front desk then sorted my insurance (made a direct claim so the insurer pays the vet directly). I left feeling that he was in the best hands possible.

Throughout the day they kept me updated and answered additional questions I had over the phone.

Upon pick up once again they were Friendly and we got a full pre op briefing with all the information we needed.

They have done a great job and made the day easy and as stress free as possible. Thank you Vets 4 pets kirkstall 🐶

We just wanted to say a HUGE thank you to the incredible team at Kirkstall. We had an awful emergency situation which required instant surgery for our dog and the staff were absolutely amazing. They saw him on arrival and rushed to give him the best care possible. Having driven up from London, we were so worried about his ongoing care but they communicated with our vet practice back home and the insurance company on our behalf to provide him with the best support. They even called on our journey home to check how he was doing and we were really touched by the kindness and professionalism of every member of staff that helped him in this horrible situation. If we were local, we would be swapping vets in an instant!
I can tell the staff here all really do love animals and take so much care with the pets. Always really easy to get appointments and advice over the phone. Could not recommend more.

Exceptional care, support and compassion from the whole team for my dog. Jo is the most amazing, wonderful vet and person in general. Lynsey goes out of her way to help and is so kind. Thankyou so much to all of you 🐾💖 …
Hardest day for me so far but the compassion (Suzanne I think she was called) was amazing, thank u so much for ur kindness and understanding, it meant more than u know

This is an outstanding vet service that has gone above and beyond to meet my families and pets needs. We have always been met with genuine kindness, and compassion during difficult times such as when my daughters hamster needed to be put to sleep. They made the process as gentle and as easy as possible. All of the staff including the vets, nurses, and receptionists are all so lovely. My pets have all recieved 5-star treatment. I have seen that even when the staff are working under pressure, that they still show up in a kind, nurturing way. They are extremely reliable, they're able to take emergency appointments, and are very flexible. I would highly recommend this service, as its not only affordable, but you will get the treatment that you and your pets deserve. Thanks to the team at vets4pets, I hope you all recieve pay rises and bonuses for the amazing work you do.

Unsanitary. Walked into a room filled with brown dog hair on the table and floor, from the previous patient I just saw leave the room. Vet did not even wipe down surfaces! Instead got a dirty blanket to lay on top of all this dog hair. A 6 minute consultation with an unbothered male vet who looked at my rabbit and said ‘he looks fine to me’ . He did zero checks on my rabbit beyond putting him on the floor to see if he walked normally. I had come in for concerns with water consumption, urine, behaviour changes and disorientation. The vet suggested putting him on antibiotics if I was worried, but without checking for signs of an infection. When complaining, the Practice Lead told me that I came to a vet for a diagnosis, so how do I know for certain he doesn’t have an infection? I said perhaps if the vet had simply inspected my rabbit or even just checked my rabbit’s temperature to see if something indicated an infection, I would be more willing to place him on more medication. Certainly a case of 5PM Friday and cannot be bothered to do fulfil their role.

A real shame, my past visits have been with a lovely vet who always throughly checks my rabbit, she listens to my concerns and outlines treatment options and possible causes and offers to refer to an exotics specialist if he needs more care. This vet is a real asset to your practice, but after my experience with the male vet today I do not wish to return to this negligent vet practice.

Excellent vets, Jo (the vet) is amazing, she was great with my strong willed Patterdale and she explains everything clearly.
Big shout out to Lindsey on reception too, she's an asset to this establishment. …

I want to do a huge shout out to Tasha & Jo. Tasha was the first student nurse I saw & we bonded instantly with the love of cats & her genuine, honest, sincere & down to earth personality. I didn't want to see anyone else but Tasha after …
